2. The present petition has been preferred for the grant of following relief(s):
"(i) for issuance of writ/order or direction including a writ in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to release the compensation amount of the acquired land according to market value after rectification of type of land as 'residential' by the Government of Bihar at village- Gandaul, Thana No. 72,
Anchal-Mahisi, District-Saharsa, which is acquired for construction of Link road with R.C.C. Bridge as enhancement of breadth of the existing road (State Highway) No.17.
(ii) for issuance a direction also to Patna High Court CWJC No.24990 of 2018(2)
dt.06-01-2026 follow all the procedure of Acquisition in accordance with Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act-2012 and classify the type of land as 'Residential instead of 'Dhanber-2 or Veeth-2'.
